data.professional_title: Senior Capital Markets Operations Specialist and Assistant Manager
data.summary: Senior Capital Markets Operations Specialist and Assistant Manager with 12+ years of experience in trade lifecycle management, settlements, corporate actions, custody operations, and reconciliation across global investment banking environments. Proven ability to reduce trade fails, manage high-volume transactions, and lead complex client migration initiatives. Skilled in financial data analysis, operational reporting, and process optimization, with expertise in SQL, Power BI, and advanced Excel for trade analytics, operational dashboards, and performance reporting.

responsibilities: Processed voluntary and mandatory corporate actions including dividends, bonus issues, stock splits, rights issues, mergers, and tender offers across global markets.
Managed end-to-end corporate action lifecycle from announcement capture to entitlement calculation and final posting.
Analyzed trade processing, trade breaks, and reconciliation data to identify operational trends, improve settlement efficiency, and support process optimization.
Supported critical business transitions and stakeholder management across U.S. and India Joint Venture teams.
Coordinated with Custody, Fund Accounting, Trade Operations, and Operations teams to resolve trade and settlement exceptions.
Monitored end-to-end trade lifecycle activities, ensuring timely trade processing, settlement, reconciliation, and exception resolution.
Worked closely with Asset Servicing and Operations teams to improve trade processing workflows and settlement efficiency.
Investigated trade breaks, cash breaks, and reconciliation exceptions, performing root cause analysis to reduce settlement failures and improve operational efficiency.
Strengthened operational controls around trade lifecycle, reconciliation, and settlement processes, reducing operational risk and improving process compliance.

Supported critical business transitions by collaborating with Asset Servicing, Operations, Middle Office, and cross-functional stakeholders across U.S. and India teams, ensuring seamless execution and adherence to SLAs.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to implement workflow enhancements.
Managed operational processing across multiple investment products including Mutual Funds, Hedge Funds, Private Equity, Equities, Fixed Income, and Alternative Investments.

Supported the end-to-end product lifecycle across Mutual Funds, Hedge Funds, Equities, Fixed Income, and Alternative Investments from trade processing, settlement, reconciliation, valuation, fund accounting, and reporting Investigated reconciliation breaks through root cause analysis and coordinated timely resolution with Operations teams.
Reviewed daily reconciliation reports and ensured all breaks were resolved within SLA.
Worked closely with Asset Servicing, Custody, Fund Accounting, Trade Operations, and Investment Operations teams to ensure smooth operational processing.
Coordinated with global operations teams for trade processing, settlement monitoring, reconciliation, and client servicing.
Supported global custody operations by ensuring accurate securities processing and timely resolution of operational exceptions
Supported Markets & Securities Services operations across Capital Markets products.
Supported Securities Operations including trade processing, settlement, reconciliation, corporate actions, and exception management.
Performed NAV validation by reconciling trades, pricing, cash, and investment positions before fund reporting.
Supported Fund Accounting operations by validating investment transactions, pricing, cash, positions, and accounting entries before NAV reporting.
Investigated trade breaks, settlement failures, cash breaks, position breaks, and corporate action exceptions.
Collaborated with Fund Managers, Custodians, Prime Brokers, Investment Managers, Asset Servicing teams, and Operations teams to resolve operational issues.
Executed trade booking, allocation, and confirmation across global markets.
Performed trade discrepancy analysis and pre-matching controls to reduce trade failures.
Monitored high-value client trades and ensured same-day settlement compliance.
Handled premium client high value trades and coordinated with Middle Office and Front Office teams.
Monitored trade settlement status and investigated failed trades to ensure timely settlement within SLA.
Coordinated with custodians, counterparties, and brokers to resolve settlement discrepancies and unmatched trades.

Validated settlement instructions (SSI), cash movements, and securities movements before settlement processing. Ensured timely settlement of equity, fixed income, and alternative investment transactions.
Supported end-to-end Fund Accounting activities including NAV validation, investment accounting, pricing validation, accruals, and financial reporting.
Processed investment transactions including purchases, sales, corporate actions, accruals, realized and unrealized gains/losses.
Performed daily NAV validation by reviewing cash, positions, pricing, and accounting entries.
Settled equity trades across global markets and managed FX deals via SWIFT.
Performed Nostro reconciliation and resolved cash and stock breaks.
Handled ETF creations, Fedwire/SWIFT settlement instructions.
Led weekly oversight calls, reduced settlement fails, and managed client escalations.
Supported financial reporting processes by performing cash and stock reconciliations across global markets.
Investigated breaks and ensured accurate posting of transactions impacting client financial statements.
Coordinated with internal control and finance teams to meet reporting deadlines and audit requirements.
Awarded for exceptional performance during high volume dividend season.

experience.company: JP Morgan India Services Pvt Ltd.
responsibilities: Performed fraud detection on cheques and monitored debit/credit transactions.
Conducted end to end KYC and AML surveillance using MANTA.
Analysed unusual activity patterns and escalated suspicious cases.
Ensured SLA adherence and supported regulatory compliance investigations.
